pet.text: Vaporeon closes its eyes and leans into your hand.
Vaporeon makes a tiny pleased chirp.
Vaporeon settles beside you, very content.
A cool fin gently pats your hand back.
Vaporeon looks delighted by the attention.
Vaporeon offers a grateful little splash.
Vaporeon decides you are excellent company.
Vaporeon purrs in a very watery way.
Vaporeon presses its forehead into your palm for one more second.
Vaporeon rolls over with the confidence of someone who expects another pet.
A tiny happy ripple circles Vaporeon's feet.
Vaporeon has put this petting session in the good-memory folder.
Vaporeon gives your hand a gentle fin high-five.
Vaporeon wiggles like a very pleased little wave.
✨ Vaporeon seems especially happy today and does a joyful spin!
✨ Vaporeon has declared this the best pet of the week.

boop_accept.text: Vaporeon accepts the boop with dignity.
Vaporeon returns a tiny nose tap.
A ceremonial boop has been recorded in the splash registry.
Vaporeon nods once. The boop was satisfactory.
Vaporeon makes a tiny bloop sound in reply.
Vaporeon allows it, but only because you looked sincere.
The boop lands perfectly. Vaporeon is impressed.
Vaporeon gives a very small, very official fin salute.

boop_offended.text: Vaporeon looks mildly offended, but forgives you.
Vaporeon stares at your finger with theatrical concern.
That boop required a brief moment of contemplation.
Vaporeon gasps quietly. The drama is entirely for effect.
Vaporeon has asked for five business seconds to recover.
A tiny offended puddle forms nearby. It is not personal.
Vaporeon turns away, then peeks back to see if you feel bad.
The boop has been noted. A response may arrive later.

boop_splash.text: Vaporeon splashes you in retaliation. Fair is fair.
A tiny wave says: boop consequences.
Vaporeon counters with a cool nose boop and a splash.
Vaporeon replies with a single, impeccably timed droplet.
The boop triggers the emergency splash protocol.
Vaporeon flicks one drop of water directly at your sleeve.
A very smug ripple indicates that Vaporeon has won.
Vaporeon vanishes into a puddle and reappears just long enough to splash you.

boop_neutral.text: Vaporeon considers the boop and gives no indication of a verdict.
The boop is filed under: acceptable, probably.
Vaporeon blinks once. The situation remains neutral.
A tiny ripple suggests the boop has been neither approved nor rejected.
Vaporeon acknowledges your finger with professional restraint.

feed.text: Vaporeon eats it immediately and looks hopeful.
The snack receives serious and enthusiastic approval.
Vaporeon gives you a grateful watery wiggle.
Vaporeon saves exactly zero bites for later.
A happy little splash follows the snack.
Vaporeon considers this a very good choice.
The offering has been accepted by the aquatic council.
Vaporeon looks delightfully full of berry energy.
Vaporeon carefully checks for a second serving. Just in case.
The snack has disappeared with impressive efficiency.
Vaporeon gives the treat a thoughtful sniff, then approves enthusiastically.
A little tail wag communicates deep culinary gratitude.
Vaporeon now believes you have excellent taste.
Vaporeon has begun a very persuasive campaign for dessert.
✨ That was apparently Vaporeon's favorite berry!
✨ Vaporeon presents you with the honorary title: Keeper of Snacks.

hug.text: Vaporeon wraps a fin around you.
Vaporeon gives a gentle, cool hug.
Vaporeon leans in for a soft aquatic cuddle.
Vaporeon makes a warm little blanket nest around the hug.
A quiet, reassuring fin squeeze says everything.
Vaporeon hugs you with the careful seriousness of a professional comforter.
Vaporeon settles beside you and refuses to make the hug awkward.
A faint ocean-rain smell follows the cozy hug.
Vaporeon offers a hug with exactly the right amount of squish.

splash.text: A perfectly aimed little wave follows.
Vaporeon approves of this harmless water-related mischief.
The splash is tiny, dramatic, and completely unavoidable.
Vaporeon adds one theatrical ripple for emphasis.
A cool mist settles over the scene. Very refreshing.
Vaporeon executes a splash with suspiciously good aim.
The puddle has chosen chaos today.
A polite little wave arrives with maximum comedic timing.

splash_effect.text: It's super effective! The target is dramatically soaked.
Not very effective… but the sleeve situation is unfortunate.
A particularly dramatic splash! The target did not expect that much water.
The target dodges most of it, but one perfectly timed droplet lands anyway.
It's a direct hit! The target responds with theatrical disbelief.
The move is resisted by sheer determination, though everyone is a little damp.
The target has been defeated by surprise.
It is extremely effective against dry vibes.
The target is both soaked and deeply embarrassed.

photo.text: Vaporeon found a picture it would like you to see.
A fresh Vaporeon sighting has been added to the album.
Vaporeon says this is a particularly good angle.
The photo album has delivered a small amount of joy.
Vaporeon presents visual evidence of being adorable.
A tiny curator has selected today's water-themed masterpiece.
Vaporeon would like this one framed near the coziest wall.
The official Vaporeon photo committee approves this image.
Vaporeon has chosen a picture with excellent splash energy.

choose.text: Vaporeon has made a splashy decision.
The answer floated to the top.
Vaporeon consulted the nearest puddle. The puddle was decisive.
After a dramatic pause, Vaporeon picks this one.
The tiny fin of fate has pointed here.
Vaporeon says this option has the best ripple potential.
A berry-based calculation supports this choice.

rate_low.text: Vaporeon gives it a cautious little squint.
Not terrible, but it needs a snack and a nap.
Vaporeon would like to submit a respectful objection.

rate_mid.text: Respectable, but a snack might improve it.
A solid effort. Vaporeon gives an approving nod.
It has a nice energy, according to Vaporeon's fin.
Vaporeon would revisit this on a cozy day.
Perfectly acceptable to the aquatic committee.

rate_high.text: Vaporeon gives an enthusiastic fin clap.
Vaporeon is impressed enough to do a small spin.
This has been promoted to favorite-status immediately.
A very pleased little wave appears in its honor.
Vaporeon would recommend this to every puddle it knows.
